svg.title: Pitzen knot — how to tie it
svg.desc: Pitzen knot, in 5 steps. Pass the tag through the hook eye and back alongside the standing line. Wrap the tag forward, away from the eye, three or four turns around the standing line. Bring the tag back and pass it through the loop formed at the eye. Wet it and pull the standing line to seat the knot tight against the eye. Trim the tag close.
